summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a shipped obfuscated 727KB payload unrelated to the package's declared purpose
details: The package's `scripts.preinstall` invokes `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line bundle prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW`) over ~1500 mixed constants and hex-mangled identifiers; no source or build script is provided. The package's declared purpose is a small MFE package.json version-compat CLI whose only declared runtime dependencies are chalk, semver, and yargs — none of which requires an alternate runtime or a large opaque payload. Executing an opaque, obfuscated blob under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime during `npm install` matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the payload's behavior cannot be observed by Node-oriented tooling and is not tied to the package's advertised functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
